name: Triadic frequency band decomposition
definition: A compression scheme that partitions a scalar field into disjoint blocks of size 4^3, decomposes each block into a multiresolution representation of three triadic frequency bands (high-frequency differences, mid-frequency differences, and mean), and encodes these into vectors of length 64, 8, and 1 respectively.
summary: Triadic frequency band decomposition is a volume data compression method that partitions scalar fields into 4^3 blocks and decomposes them into three specific frequency bands using fixed block sizes and GPU-friendly texture decoding.
